findings.finding: React/ReactDOM 19.1.0, React Router, assinatura Vite e Tailwind 4.1.3.
Regra nominal de 10% para minimal no código; duas apresentações vistas.
Não há resultado interno para comparar conversão das variantes.
Campos adicionais e modo isEnrichment no cliente; não executados contra a API.
Streak, indicação, missões e cupons compõem uma proposta de recorrência.
Cinco rotas do leitor redirecionam ao login, contando missões.
Blocos comerciais na edição, entrada comercial e oferta de patrocínio.
Declarações públicas de audiência não foram auditadas; não há dados financeiros.
Tela de confirmação e contrato no código não demonstram envio ou recebimento.
Protótipo próprio com jornadas simuladas e 18 verificações aprovadas.

E01: Artifact identity is unavailable for this observation.
Event sequence records provider receipt order; simultaneous browser causality is not inferred.
Network content is retained only when selected; Playwright response-body bytes are API results and are not guaranteed to match wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
Some network requests had not completed when capture ended; later activity is unknown.
Browser host platform and architecture were not observed.
E02: CommonJS and ESM binding relationships were recovered from inert syntax and resolved only within the inventoried artifact container.
Graph coverage is incomplete; unavailable facts remain explicit and must not be read as absence.
JavaScript and HTML were parsed as inert text; bundle bootstrap code was never executed.
Static imports, entrypoints, workers, endpoints, and storage relationships do not prove runtime execution.
Static paths and relationships may remain unresolved when expressions are dynamic or obfuscated.
Webpack/Rspack factories were recovered from AST literals; REA did not invoke push handlers or bundle bootstrap code.
